redhat.leapp Ansible collection that handles Rocky Linux upgrades.

Security Fix(es):

* ansible-collection-redhat-leapp: ansible-collection-redhat-leapp: Information disclosure of PostgreSQL data via insecure backup permissions (CVE-2026-68563)

* ansible-collection-redhat-leapp: ansible-collection-redhat-leapp: Information disclosure via Leapp report tampering (CVE-2026-68562)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
